units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:1">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> Sivan, the seventh month <he>להַפְסָקַת וכ׳</he> counting from the time the rains ceased (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 59:1">Yalk. ib. 59</cite> <he>לירידת</he>).
<cite ref="Taanit 4b:8">Taan. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>לה׳</he> with reference to ceasing to insert the mention of rain in the prayers.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:15">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>, end <he>אין כאן ה׳</he> there is nothing intervening (between <cite ref="F00049"><he>ויקרא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="F00033"><he>וידבר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 1:1">Lev. I, 1</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>הַפְסָקוֹת</he>.

Num. R. s. 14, end ה׳ the intervals in revelations, i.e. passages in the Pentateuch not introduced by vayikra and vaydabber.—Esp. Hafsakah, the Sabbath intervening between the four Sabbaths on which the sections of the Torah, Sh’kalim, Zakhor, Parah and Haḥodesh are severally read, v. פָּרָשָׁה.
<cite ref="Megillah 30a:25">Meg. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>שנייה לה׳</he> ‘the second Sabbath’ means that following the Hafsakah.
